text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliamentary session to end on Saturday September 5.
- Health ministry suggests that foriegners pay 30 to 40 dinars for health insurance.
- Parliament amends bill by government for payment of electricity and water bills.
- Budget revenue for 1996/97 estimated at three billion dinars, expenditure put at 4.21 billion dinars. Parliament has yet to pass the budget for the fiscal year which started July 1.
- Some six million dinars worth of real estate to be sold on Tuesday in the third real estate public auction.
- No U.S. plan to topple Iraqi President Saddam Hussein, Kuwait says.
